_metadata.description: Mexican international student mobility trends - time series and breakdowns

sources.open_doors: IIE Open Doors Report via CSIS, ICEF Monitor, Hispanic Outlook. Full time series TBD from opendoorsdata.org download.
sources.sevis: DHS SEVP SEVIS Data Mapping Tool monthly snapshots (already in /data/sevp/)
sources.icef: ICEF Monitor Feb 2025 article on Mexico international student recruitment
sources.csis: CSIS 2024 analysis: Educational Exchange as a Strategic Priority in U.S.-Mexico Relations

notes: Open Doors data uses academic year (e.g., 2023/24 = fall 2023 - spring 2024).
SEVIS data is point-in-time monthly snapshots of active F-1/M-1 records. Higher than Open Doors because it includes OPT, language training, K-12.
Several years still need confirmation from full Open Doors download. Values marked 'estimated' are interpolated from surrounding data points.
Mexico's college-age population grew from under 2 million in 2000 to 4 million in 2025.

international_students_in_mexico_inbound._note: Survey-based, not census. Mexico does not report to OECD. Newer data may exist in 2023 Patlani report.

conacyt_secihti_scholarships._note: CONACYT renamed CONAHCYT (2023), then became SECIHTI ministry (2024-25). International scholarship funding largely eliminated under new administration. Specific historical counts need extraction from annual reports.
conacyt_secihti_scholarships.policy_shift: International scholarship awards almost completely eliminated; financing redirected toward domestic scholarships
conacyt_secihti_scholarships.2025_status: Central call for full PhD funding abroad opened March 17, 2025 - covers tuition, fees, health insurance, living expenses (max 2yr Masters, 4yr PhD)
